mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST < 1000) and real personal consumption (RSAFS < 420000) signals a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST < 1000 and RSAFS < 420000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a supply shock that disrupts production chains and increases input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through margin pressure on corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate demand effects.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in quarterly GDP (GDPC1 < 16000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1000) signals a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 < 16000 and HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates sustained accommodative monetary policy that supports long-term equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through extended low discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.
